support_page_cycle_story: Chedak abo do nowa bon kami kana ↻
support_story_1_headline: Manufacturer ko laha idi len khan somaj do step up huyuk kana.
support_story_1_lead: Amak’ jinis thir hardwear traps ar rạput’ akan sudhrạo khọn rukhiạ me̱.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis do̠ Y1 lekan khelạḍiạko lạgit́ nãwã nãwã firmware ko so̠do̠ra (6.0, 7.0, ar 8.0 lekan ạḍi gạhir board reaḱ sudhrạo ko lạgit́) oka do̠ thir hapẽ kate mare jinis ko bạṛić ocoet́ kana. Ar ona khon hõ bạṛićaḱ do̠ hoyoḱ kana, onkoaḱ website do̠ brick reaḱ ạt khon ruạṛ lạgit́ pạhil kạmikan firmware reaḱ zero cet́et́kanko ar zero ạidạri ko emda. Updaṭar ar Somaj Firmware Projekṭ do̠ hạṭińko hataoeda: abo do̠ sanam legacy stock ROM bon archive eda, apnar tege apnar harḍware reaḱ sudhrạo bon sạbit̕a, ar apnar khelạḍiạ do̠ ạḍi sạṅgiń te calao idieda.
support_story_1_item_1: Rạput́ khilạḍiạkọ bańcao: rukhiạ biḍạo gọṭae me̱ je̱ nawa update tis hõ mare harḍwear baṅ iṭạ.
support_story_1_item_2: Arkaiv sṭok roms: asol karkhana phārmwēra rēẏāga purā sā'ōtē inniōsis ḍiliṭa ēji.
support_story_1_item_3: Neṭiv krōs-plēṭaphorma: macOS, linux āra windows lāgida miṭa lāgida purā jhālāga jinisa.
support_story_1_item_4: Harḍwear ạkil: Aṭomatik bọrḍ ḍeṭekṭeṭ jemon jaoge sạri package ńam.
support_story_2_headline: Guogle ḍraiv do̠ baṅ rạput́ akana. Andaz-kạmi do̠ baṅ. Khali phạrmware kạmi kana.
support_story_2_lead: Ạḍi tạpis, sạbit’ akan somaj reak’ ạri-cạli cetan re̱ am sạri ge̱ hirlạ daṛeak’a.
support_story_2_body: Ạḍi jạruṛan innioasis softwear ńam reaḱ mane do̠ hoyoḱ kana google ḍraiv link, goć akan baidu klauḍ hạṭiń, ar jahan jạpit́ jinis bạnuḱte rahas jip fail ko lạgit́ forum ko sendra ńam. Ale̱ mit’ pạtiạr, phurgạl ḍaunlod jọtọr benao akada SHA-256 sọtọrkọ, nawatet’ gọṭae, ar taṛam-taṛam te̱ ạcuo akan insṭol são. Apeak̕ dan do̠ direct ḍaunlod ar hosting ko dohoe kana oka do̠ 24 ghanta, 365 din bochor re noa do̠ hoe daṛeak̕.
support_story_2_item_1: Sidha-gạḍi CDN: Sidha, sidha ḍaunlod jahan ḍaunlod hạṭiń se goć link baṅ tahena.
support_story_2_item_2: Update No̠tifikaṭion: Nawa somaj reak̕ release se̠ thik kạmi lạgit̕ oka okte ge alert hoyok̕a.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided paṭ paṭ te̱ install: safa ńel reak’ udgạk’ sanam boṭon press reak’ tala te̱ amak’ calao et’ kana.
support_story_2_item_4: Aema pạrsiren somaj: Inglish, cini, jarman, spanish, phransis ar japan pạrsi te purạte sạdhin.
support_story_3_headline: Innioasis khelạḍiạkoak̕ purạ ạidạri jhić lạgit̕.
support_story_3_lead: Rockbox, kasṭm halka ọjọn ọpọreṭing sistạm ar ọḍiophil phurgạl ạgu.
support_story_3_body: Stock karkhana reaḱ softwear do eken ona reaḱ ḍhertet́e ḍeṅga aṭkar eda oka do amaḱ Y1 se Y2 harḍware cet́e ceka daṛeaḱa. Aboak’ sọmaj rockbox, halka kasṭm ọpọreṭing sistạm, oḍiophil kodek plebek, ar kasṭm thime̱ jivọn re̱ ạgu keda. Ale̱ biḍạo, ulṭạu injiniọr ar sanam insṭol reak’ gọṭae lạgit họṛmọ harḍwear bọdọlọk’ jọb khọn bahre̱ kiriń et’ kana. Upḍēṭāra sā'ōtē nōẏā biḍāra unit kō ḍāẏa āra kasṭama phārmwaẏāra utnạu tēga ēji.
support_story_3_item_1: Miṭa klik rōkbāksa: ōḍiẏā'ila phlēbēka ēbaṁ kasṭama thēma sēkenḍa rē insṭāla ēji.
support_story_3_item_2: Sọmaj pharmwear: beṭri sudhrạo, sapha UI ar nahaḱ ọḍio kodek gọṛọ.
support_story_3_item_3: Akṭiv Hardware Lab: Jaha ge̠ benao̠ lạgit́ pạhil re̠ sạri physical jinis re̠ biḍạu bon kạmieda.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero blōṭaweẏāra: 100% phā'ōla, gōnāẏa-pạhil sōphṭa'ōẏyāra jāhāra bāṁ biḍāpasa āra ṭrākaṁ.
support_story_4_headline: Innioasis oka bako kamikan ona kami lagid gorobon.
support_story_4_lead: Amak’ jiniskọ landphill khọn bahre̱ dọhọ et’ kana sọmaj darae te̱ calak’ kan firmwear rakha.
support_story_4_body: Jọkhec’ mit’ harḍwear kọ͂mpạni amak’ daraekan gejet re̱ senọk’ kana, unre mare modelkọ bọdọr et’ kana. Innioasis do̠ Linux reaḱ jãhãn goṛo do̠ bae emda, jãhãn ạḍi sạri bo̠do̠l kạmi do̠ baṅ, ar jãhãn install bạṛić lenkhan ạḍi algate ạḍi jạruṛaḱ kạmi do̠ baṅ hoyoḱ kana. Updater do̠ menak̕a cedak̕ je ạḍi mo̠ńj beohar ko̠ṛako do̠ ạḍi bhage music player ko̠ ḍe̠ṅga aṭkar jạruṛa. 100% somaj reak̕ kạmi do̠ direct noa tool sanamko lạgit̕ jhić dohoe re calak̕ kana.
support_story_4_item_1: Bańcao & Unbrick: Device ko boot lạgit́ ko manao lekhan hõ sạbit sudhrạo do̠ calao̠ḱ kana.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux pạhil ḍạr gọṛọ: linux disṭros re̱ purạte̱ gọṛọ akana mediatek jạpit́et́ kana.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Bodol: Bichnạo release note jemon am do̠ thik te̠m baḍae daṛeaḱ cet́ bo̠do̠l hoyoḱ kana.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Somaj reak̕ kạmi: Jo̠to̠ ko̠phi archive do̠ sanamko lạgit̕ jhić ar begor kạmi te̠ dohoe kana.
